svg.title: Жим гантелей на полу — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. TWO-DUMBBELL FLOOR PRESS. Both figures lie face up directly on FLOOR with knees bent/feet planted. NO bench. Left: one dumbbell each hand at sides of chest, elbows bent and upper arms touching floor, forearms vertical. Right: arms press dumbbells vertically above chest with elbows nearly straight; separate dumbbells remain in both hands, no barbell. Side three-quarter view makes back and elbow FLOOR contact clear. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
